summary: Post-refactor regression sweep. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass (up from 13/17 in iteration_1) — includes the 3 previously-failing bugs (feedback ObjectId leak, brute-force lockout, GET /api/ root) all now fixed. Added new coverage: admin-can-not-bid (403), logout, soft-close (both extension and no-extension paths), and Socket.IO new_bid event schema. Frontend smoke: home + browse + login (admin/bidder/seller) + auction detail + admin console + notifications bell all render correctly with no console errors after auth. Circular-import cleanup (db.py) is working — backend restarts clean, no import errors.

issues: Still uses browser-native <input type=datetime-local> for start/end time instead of shadcn Calendar+Popover. Carried over from iteration_1 — not fixed in this refactor pass.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Replace native datetime-local pickers on /auctions/new with shadcn Calendar for design consistency.

(Optional / carry-over from iteration_1 code review) server.py is 1018 lines — consider splitting into auth/auctions/bids/admin/sockets modules for maintainability. db.py extraction is a good first step, keep going.
(Optional) _bid_lock is still a single global asyncio.Lock — bottleneck for concurrent auctions. Consider per-auction lock dict or MongoDB findOneAndUpdate atomic.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactors look clean: db.py extraction resolves the circular import, _validate_bid_against_auction / _apply_soft_close are small and testable, timedelta import is proper, AuthContext/NotificationsContext memoization uses useMemo+useCallback correctly, image keys switched to URL (removes React key-collision warnings on reorder), console.warn instead of empty catches — good for future debugging.

Soft-close correctness verified end-to-end: bid at T-30s extends end_time to T+60s and payload flags extended=true/extension_seconds=60; bid at T-5min leaves end_time untouched and returns extended=false/extension_seconds=0. Socket.IO new_bid payload correctly carries end_time/extended/extension_seconds fields.
server.py line count (1018) still exceeds the 700-line guideline; split into modules recommended in a future pass.
Global _bid_lock across all auctions is still a scalability concern (unchanged since iteration_1).
test_credentials: admin@bidbridge.com / Admin@12345 · seller@bidbridge.com / Seller@12345 · bidder@bidbridge.com / Bidder@12345 — all validated.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds admin/seller/bidder + 8 categories + 4 demo auctions on startup. Tests also create TEST_-prefixed auctions (deleted by soft-close test on completion; others left in place for UI verification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now has 21 tests covering all documented endpoints + soft-close + Socket.IO. To re-run: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v`. Requires websocket-client (auto-installed by this iteration) and pymongo (already installed) — test reads MONGO_URL/DB_NAME directly from /app/backend/.env stripping surrounding quotes. Socket.IO test connects via polling transport at /api/socket.io with Bearer token from login response body.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all previously-reported iteration_1 bugs (feedback ObjectId leak, brute-force lockout, GET /api/) are verified fixed and stayed fixed after the refactor. Soft-close feature works exactly per spec (SOFT_CLOSE_WINDOW_SECONDS=60).
